summary: Assign planner to define a bounded research question targeting a specific benchmark comparing dynamic vs. static memory under fixed token budgets.
objective: Define a bounded research question targeting a specific, reproducible benchmark (e.g., LongMemEval or MemoryAgentBench) that explicitly compares dynamic consolidation policies against a defined static baseline under fixed token budgets. Limit to 4 sources. Do not implement.
